typography.name: Klim Type Foundry
typography.note: One huge inflated black 'A' fills an orange screen; a single letterform is the whole hero.

typography.name: Instrument
typography.note: Ultra-heavy wordmark set edge to edge as the masthead, with small condensed caps in pill nav.

typography.name: Commercial Type
typography.note: Full-width bands each set one typeface huge: hairline New Doric, fat Orlando serif, Arabic.

typography.name: Future Fonts
typography.note: Giant specimen lines of quirky display serifs and italics fill the page behind a tiny CTA.

typography.name: Velvetyne
typography.note: Brutalist text-only index with letterspaced labels, then full-bleed specimens like ornate 'Deede la fractura'.

typography.name: Sharp Type
typography.note: Sentences mix the fonts they describe inline: slab, mono, grotesque, italic, beside an outline 3D word.

typography.name: Lineto
typography.note: A printed weight ladder, Regular to Black Italic, beside a magazine cover using the same face.

typography.name: Grilli Type
typography.note: Test-card hero spelling MCNK, then a clean two-column list where each name is set in itself.

typography.name: OH no Type Co
typography.note: Italic mono nav, then black-and-white posters and a bold CAMELION specimen that show the fonts in use.

typography.name: Typotheque
typography.note: Heavy 'Chairman' wordmark over a dense halftone texture, above a row of bright category cards.

typography.name: COLLINS
typography.note: A lone classical serif line, 'Rewrite your worth.', centred in a lot of empty space.

typography.name: Pangram Pangram Foundry
typography.note: Rounded photo cards, each named with its own typeface in huge bold white text, like 'Neue Gstaad'.

colour.name: Gumroad
colour.note: Off-white page with black type and one loud pink on the floating outlined coins.

colour.name: Arc
colour.note: Grainy electric-blue bands with wavy edges frame a soft pastel-and-white middle.

colour.name: MSCHF
colour.note: Black and grey mono list where only three lines glow yellow, blue and red.

colour.name: Resend
colour.note: All-black dark mode: grey-to-white gradient serif headline, matte black cube, and no accent hue.

colour.name: Hello Monday
colour.note: Pure black-on-white line drawings and serif type, with a black curved panel as the only block.

colour.name: Wise
colour.note: Black heavy caps on white, with lime-green buttons as the single brand accent.

colour.name: Pitch
colour.note: Everything tinted one violet, from banner to background, with a lone lime 'Sign up' button.

colour.name: Supabase
colour.note: Neutral white and grey UI where green only marks the second headline line and the main CTA.

colour.name: Duolingo
colour.note: Mostly white screen; bright owl green carries the logo, mascot and main button.

layout.name: Grilli Type
layout.note: A narrow label column on the left and a wide content column; typeface names line up on a strict grid.

layout.name: 14islands
layout.note: The headline is staggered across columns, with a small label offset to the right and wide margins all round.

layout.name: Sharp Type
layout.note: Asymmetric: the logo sits in a side column, the storefront image is pushed right, with open white space around it.

layout.name: Obys Agency
layout.note: An editorial three-zone layout: project index on the left, a centred column of images, studio info on the right.

layout.name: Work & Co
layout.note: A classic two-column grid: labels in a narrow left column, content in the wide right one, with hairline rules between sections.

layout.name: Kinfolk
layout.note: Generous white space: one centred cover and a serif title with lots of room around them.

layout.name: Pentagram — Work
layout.note: An uneven one-third / two-thirds project grid under a large 'Work' title, with a consistent left edge.

layout.name: AnOther Magazine
layout.note: An editorial split: a half-width photo next to a serif headline, with a four-column row of stories below.

hierarchy.name: Collins
hierarchy.note: One large serif line in empty space, then a small row of award laurels. The reading order is obvious.

hierarchy.name: Instrument
hierarchy.note: A full-width black INSTRUMENT wordmark dominates, and the featured case study sits clearly below it.

hierarchy.name: Commercial Type
hierarchy.note: Each colour band has one huge typeface name first, with a tiny style count as the second read.

hierarchy.name: Pangram Pangram
hierarchy.note: Reads top to bottom: a huge 'Neue Gstaad' name, a short tagline, then two buttons.

hierarchy.name: Hello Monday / DEPT
hierarchy.note: A line illustration leads, then a tiny eyebrow line, then the big serif word 'Branding'.

hierarchy.name: Arc
hierarchy.note: A centred serif headline, a grey subline, one dark 'Try Dia' button, then the product screenshot.

hierarchy.name: LOEWE
hierarchy.note: A giant white LOEWE wordmark over one full-bleed product photo. Only two things compete for attention.

hierarchy.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
hierarchy.note: Finnish page. Product name, then a huge bold claim, then a small subline, with price and Buy set apart.

footer.name: 14islands
footer.note: The footer is a closing invitation: a big 'Let's make something great' line, a huge email address, and a minimal social row.

footer.name: Collins
footer.note: A dark footer with big serif section links, a pill 'Work with us' button, a newsletter field and socials.

footer.name: Instrument
footer.note: A complete footer: newsletter pitch, three labelled link columns and a legal bar, all on a strict grid.

footer.name: Pangram Pangram
footer.note: A rounded card holding the full font index, grouped links, a newsletter field and payment logos, plus 'Back to top'.

footer.name: Arc
footer.note: A playful footer: a wavy edge, a download CTA band, then two link columns and a serif signature on grainy blue.

footer.name: Koto
footer.note: The footer is a contact page, with labelled rows for press, recruitment and channels, and a studio video tile.

footer.name: Sharp Type
footer.note: Every typeface is listed with a coloured dot, in three columns, beside a newsletter sign-up and utility links.

footer.name: Work & Co
footer.note: A calm, complete footer: subscribe prompt, then Contact, Headquarters and Utilities columns with real addresses.

footer.name: Rive
footer.note: A dark product footer: six labelled link columns (Product to Case Studies), a wordmark, legal text and a row of social icons.

footer.name: Displaay
footer.note: Fonts are grouped by style (Sans, Serif, Other), with site links, socials, the 'DD' logo mark and a legal bar.

motion.name: Hello Monday
motion.note: Hand-drawn animated couple above a rotating serif word, with a curved black menu edge peeking in.

motion.name: Aristide Benoist
motion.note: Caught mid-intro: thin vertical photo strips sliding into place under a tick-mark progress bar.

motion.name: Active Theory
motion.note: Real-time WebGL scene: glossy chrome ribbon logo floating among drifting golden particles and a jellyfish.

motion.name: monopo london
motion.note: Grainy animated orange-and-blue gradient waves behind the headline, with a glass lens cursor bottom right.

motion.name: makemepulse
motion.note: Kinetic staggered headline, 'global creative studio.', whose letters morph between typeface styles.

motion.name: GSAP
motion.note: 'Animate anything' hero with playful 3D squiggle and pinwheel shapes animating over giant type.

motion.name: Rive
motion.note: Column of live interactive animation demos (thermostat, game UI, mobile app) running beside the pitch.

motion.name: Dogstudio
motion.note: Iridescent 3D wolf with drifting leaves behind a huge serif headline. Headline contains a swear word.

motion.name: Exo Ape
motion.note: Full-bleed Venice dome photo with an oversized 'Digital' wordmark sliding up from the bottom edge.

scroll.name: Jesko Jets
scroll.note: Scroll-scrubbed paragraph: words fill from faded to solid white as you scroll over clouds.

scroll.name: Oryzo
scroll.note: Pinned 3D cork coaster rotating mid-scroll between the headline and copy, lit like a product film.

scroll.name: Zentry
scroll.note: Mid-scroll, a skewed 3D-tilted media card sits under heavy condensed type, transforming as the page moves.

scroll.name: Shopify Editions Summer '25
scroll.note: Storefront mockup tilted in 3D perspective with a purple glow, and a pill-shaped chapter nav on the left.

scroll.name: Adaline
scroll.note: Product UI panel pinned over a painted fantasy landscape, zooming in as the story scrolls.

scroll.name: Lando Norris
scroll.note: Staggered parallax photos and a signed quote drifting at different speeds over contour-line background.

scroll.name: Opal
scroll.note: Manifesto text scrolls over a pinned still life of prototypes and parts on a glass table.

scroll.name: The Pudding: Song Repetition
scroll.note: Classic scrollytelling: step cards on the left update a sticky lyrics graphic on the right.

scroll.name: Apple Vision Pro
scroll.note: Headline fades out as a full-bleed video of floating app icons scrolls into view.

3d.name: ThreeUI
3d.note: A library of three.js landing pages, hero sections and shaders: browse, copy, install via CLI.

3d.name: Messenger
3d.note: Tiny cel-shaded 3D planet of houses and trees with blocky 3D title letters floating over it.

3d.name: Oryzo
3d.note: Photoreal real-time cork coaster on a cutting mat, pencils and knife lit like a product shoot.

3d.name: Dogstudio
3d.note: Iridescent 3D wolf with drifting leaves behind a huge serif headline, lit in violet and teal.

3d.name: Spline
3d.note: Soft glossy 3D shapes and a voxel bunny float over a perspective grid around a prompt box.

3d.name: Shopify Editions Winter '24
3d.note: Pale lilac 3D plinths hold product cards, chrome sparkles and a terminal, under giant FOUNDATIONS type.

3d.name: Dala
3d.note: A brain built from thousands of colored 3D triangle particles beside a big white sans headline.

3d.name: Zentry
3d.note: Glowing wireframe crystal form rendered inside a clipped, tilted black frame on electric violet.

3d.name: Chipsa
3d.note: Textured grey 3D rock forms rise from the bottom of a quiet light page with condensed caps headline.

3d.name: David Heckhoff
3d.note: Clay-style 3D room of a developer at a desk with monitors, plant and penguin, as a portfolio hero.

3d.name: Noomo
3d.note: Frosted-glass 3D pixel shapes refract and blur the large mono headline they float across.

shaders.name: Monopo London
shaders.note: Grainy orange and blue light ribbons sweep across black behind white headline, full-bleed shader field.

shaders.name: ShaderGradient
shaders.note: Full-screen grainy orange-to-pink moving gradient with an elegant serif title laid over it.

shaders.name: Paper Shaders
shaders.note: Grid of the same flower photo run through paper texture, fluted glass, water and halftone shaders.

shaders.name: Radiant
shaders.note: A glowing black-hole accretion disk shader in a starfield, with live chromatic, intensity and speed sliders.

shaders.name: Unicorn Studio
shaders.note: Violet aurora light beams with sparkles glow up from the bottom of a dark hero card.

shaders.name: ertdfgcvb
shaders.note: The whole page is a generative ASCII field: characters flow in columns around plain text links.

shaders.name: Kenta Toshikura
shaders.note: Film-grain, dust and RGB-split distortion on a circular image behind bold stencil type.

shaders.name: Hume AI
shaders.note: Generative flowing line waves in pink, peach and lilac fill a rounded panel under a warm light hero.

shaders.name: A flowing WebGL gradient
shaders.note: A live tilted band of flowing magenta-orange noise gradient cuts across a dark article page.

shaders.name: COBE
shaders.note: Minimal white dotted WebGL globe with arcs and labelled markers, drawn by a 5KB shader.

components.name: shadcn/ui
components.note: Live component wall: pill buttons, inputs, badges, checkbox and toggle row, bar-chart card, QR card.

components.name: Radix Themes
components.note: Serif headline beside real cards: team list with invite field, notification toggles in blue.

components.name: Park UI
components.note: Tilted stack of working cards: sign-up form, payment method picker, black toggles, product tile.

components.name: Rive
components.note: Column of interactive UI demos (smart-watch face, game menu, mobile puzzle) beside tabbed CLI install card.

components.name: 8bitcn
components.note: Playful pixel-art system: chunky 8-bit buttons, HP progress bars, dropdowns, dialogue box, command menu.

components.name: NeoBrutalism (RetroUI)
components.note: Brutalist buttons with hard offset shadows, yellow highlight headline, bordered chat card with inline CTA.

components.name: Aceternity UI components
components.note: Component gallery grid: each card previews an effect (generation loader, chromatic image, cloud shader).

components.name: Motion Examples
components.note: Pattern library UI: ASCII-glyph banner, filter checkboxes, platform list, featured particle-morph spotlight card.

hero.name: Collins
hero.note: One serif line, 'Rewrite your worth.', centred in vast off-white space above small award laurels.

hero.name: Instrument
hero.note: Edge-to-edge black ultra-heavy wordmark over a rounded case-study video panel; pill nav buttons.

hero.name: 14islands
hero.note: Huge staggered 'Design & Technology' type on grey, grey ampersand, tiny caps tagline, nothing else.

hero.name: Pangram Pangram
hero.note: Rounded photo card of Alps with giant 'Neue Gstaad' set in the typeface, two small CTAs.

hero.name: Klim Type Foundry
hero.note: Single full-bleed image: orange crate stacked on black crate, grey ground, one tiny font label.

hero.name: Active Theory
hero.note: Dark WebGL scene: iridescent 3D 'a' logo ring on a looping ribbon, bokeh particles, glass nav pill.

hero.name: Hello Monday
hero.note: Two hand-drawn characters above rotating serif word 'Products'; black blob menu on right edge.

hero.name: Arc / Dia
hero.note: Wavy blue frame, serif 'Meet Dia' headline, one dark app-icon CTA, browser product shot below.

hero.name: Pentagram
hero.note: Full-width case-study image (yellow cubes, Isomorphic Labs mark) with interactive 'We design ___ for ___' sentence.

bento.name: MacBook Pro
bento.note: Dark rounded tiles of mixed sizes: photo tiles with big claims beside icon-only tiles for ports, gaming.

bento.name: Supabase
bento.note: One wide Postgres tile plus seven product tiles, each with a small line-art illustration of its feature.

bento.name: Clerk
bento.note: Dark bento of auth features: tall session-management tile, OTP boxes, SSO node graph, magic-link card.

bento.name: Notion
bento.note: Two big grey tiles with arrow buttons holding real product UI (meetings table, deal dashboard), wide tile below.

bento.name: Tailwind CSS
bento.note: Feature tiles each with a live demo: sepia filter photo, draggable light/dark split on a banking card.

bento.name: Mintlify
bento.note: Wide-plus-narrow top row, three tiles below; soft beige tiles tied together by flowing green lines.

bento.name: Cal.com
bento.note: 2x2 grid of white cards, each a benefit headline over a real settings or booking-link UI fragment.
